cases.assertion: Repository inspection returns normalized metadata and never an authenticated URL or credential value.
A redirect to a different canonical origin fails with ORIGIN_MISMATCH and is not followed with credentials.
Health performs a finite authenticated read-only repository probe and causes no remote mutation.
A fetch request containing user information, an unregistered origin, refspec, config override, or arbitrary output path is rejected before network or filesystem mutation.
Fetch runs with hooks, credential helpers, protocol.ext, recursive submodules, and uncontrolled environment disabled.
Retrying one ambiguous fetch with the same operation_id converges without changing any pinned Workspace base SHA.
An unavailable mirror root reports UNOBSERVABLE rather than NOT_FOUND or OBSERVED_ABSENT.
Two Workspaces from one pinned SHA use distinct working trees and cannot observe each other's index or untracked files.
A symlink or path replacement escaping the allocated Workspace root is rejected after real-path revalidation at use time.
Stage, unstage, and restore reject a stale expected Workspace revision with CONFLICT.
Workspace revision inputs change for tracked content, index state, untracked paths, and untracked content; HEAD alone is insufficient.
An orphan worktree containing unpublished changes is quarantined and never automatically deleted.
Create accepts only product identities, generation, operation_id, profile name, and Workspace projection handle; raw provider specifications are rejected.
Ownership and operation identity are established atomically in the provider create call.
Retry with the same operation_id observes the existing owned resource before create and does not create a duplicate.
A stale generation fails with STALE_GENERATION and is never redirected to the current generation.
The sandbox cannot access the bare mirror, Git administration, sibling Workspaces, control-plane or blob roots, broker endpoints, daemon endpoints, or Git credentials.
Destroy rejects foreign or missing ownership, stale generation, unavailable authority, and insufficient durable observation evidence.
Execution uses argv without implicit shell interpolation and rejects an environment name outside the allowlist.
The working directory is revalidated inside the assigned Workspace projection immediately before execution.
Output beyond the configured bound is explicitly marked truncated and raw output never appears in the normalized error envelope.
A deadline or lost response after dispatch becomes UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and blocks further execution on that generation.
A provider without execution-observation-by-operation-id requires explicit operator resolution and never automatically redispatches.
Cancellation distinguishes requested, delivered, and process-exit-confirmed; only the final state proves termination.
When Git metadata is hidden, every Command Run and Test Run reports GitMetadataUnavailable even if exit code is zero.
Unknown or unevidenced capabilities remain UNKNOWN or UNSUPPORTED and cannot satisfy a required profile capability.
A provider, host, or adapter version change invalidates the prior immutable capability snapshot.
Profile evaluation reports every required, missing, degraded, and satisfied capability without creating a resource.
Provider unavailability yields UNAVAILABLE and cannot be interpreted as resource absence.
Logs and safe diagnostics contain no credential, authenticated URL, uncontrolled provider error body, environment value, or raw command output.
